text: The subject Shahid Mirza holds account PK**MUCB****3758 which was opened on 9 August 2018. The declared occupation is Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 185,000 per month. During the activity window of 2 May 2026 to 24 May 2026 the account recorded 12 credits totalling PKR 16,043,000 and 3 debits totalling PKR 12,466,000. The cash activity comprised 11 cash deposits totalling PKR 15,858,000 made across three branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 24 May 2026, with the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scoring 320 against a threshold of 300. Eight of the eleven cash deposits (73%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, which is consistent with the structuring hypothesis. The deposits were spread across three branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), consistent with the structuring hypothesis. More than one cash deposit occurred on a single day, 13 May 2026, which is another indicator of structuring. The credits in the activity window were 86.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 185,000 per month, suggesting a volume inconsistent with the stated earnings, supporting the structuring hypothesis. A branch note dated 14 May 2026 records the customer asking why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declining to explain the source of the cash, which is indicative of structuring. Overall, the pattern of multiple near‑threshold cash deposits across several branches, the single‑day multiple deposits, the high cash volume relative to a declared income of PKR 185,000 per month and the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000 is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 9,691,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank C) in two transactions. PKR 2,775,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank B) in one transaction. Debits equal to 78% of credits were made with a median of 28.8 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 28 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
